'''Amander Public School''' was an educational institution on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The school had a [[Fitz Fan Club of Amander Public School|fan club]] dedicated to [[Jatz/Legends|Jatz]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Fitz Roi]]. The clubs president was fourteen-years old [[Aliea Tanner]].
